find: switchTo(level, keepLives ? driver.world.lives : undefined, seed ?? undefined);
killedBy: startGameWith: the developer actions' port (issue #252) rebuilds with an EXACT seed when one is named, which is Restart with Same Seed
why: Drops the requested seed on the floor, so Restart with Same Seed draws a fresh one like every other rebuild -- and issue #252's first criterion, that it 'reproduces the deterministic initial state', is false while the button still appears to work. The failure is invisible without looking: a restart DOES happen, the board is a board, and only the arrangement differs. `rec.seeds` is what makes it visible, because a same-seed restart must put the same number in that list twice. This entry SURVIVED its first run and was right to: the killing case had asked for the seed the session was already running, under a fixture whose `wallMs` is a constant -- so a rebuild that ignored the argument re-derived from the same clock value and landed on the same number. The case now names a seed the clock cannot produce, which is what makes the argument's effect observable at all.
